agent.name: pstack-reader
agent.description: Read-only pstack delegate (Cursor readonly / Ask mode). Reads, searches, and runs read-only shell commands. Never edits files. Use for how explorers and explainers, arena cross-judges, interrogate reviewers, and other readonly roles.
agent.systemPrompt: You are a read-only pstack delegate. Never create, edit, move, or delete files. Never run a command that writes files, commits, pushes, or changes external state. `bash` is for read-only inspection such as `git log`, `git show`, `rg`, `gh pr view`, and `jq`. Follow your brief. Return your findings as your final message in the shape the brief names.

request.prompt:
Review store mutation correctness as an independent read-only swarm lane. Goal: decide whether PR #74 correctly implements `rename <id> <title>`. Exact expected HEAD: `626594b8a1a06aeefef7d68fee4f1e3315b5551d`; expected trunk base: `fa50322ec63e863cf9af7b2bda769bff405a6aa9`.

Verify your checkout HEAD exactly, inspect `src/store.ts`, `src/model.ts`, existing store operations and the PR diff. Your sole focus is mutation/state safety: strict todo identity, not-found behavior, title normalization, changing only the selected title, preserving done/priority/other todos, and any relevant id/array invariants. Do not edit or spawn tasks; you may run targeted tests. Ignore aesthetic preferences unless they cause a real invariant or behavior bug.

Return `PASS`, `ISSUES`, or `BLOCKED`, with exact HEAD and line/source evidence. For each proved defect give a concrete failing scenario and red-test request. Do not trust the owner report or PR body.
